newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Syntech sells Malaysian stake.
newsitem.headline: Siam Syntech sells Malaysian stake.

text.p: Thai construction contractor Siam Syntech Construction Plc said on Wednesday its wholly owned Malaysian subsidiary had sold three million shares in Plantation and Development (Malaysia) Bhd for 200.86 million baht ($7.73 million).

Siam Syntech said its Syntech Co Ltd unit in Malaysia sold its stake in Plantation and Development to a Malaysian buyer for 19.50 million ringgit. The deal was arranged by Malaysian brokerage firm Alor Setar Securities Sdn Bhd .
It said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the sale would be booked in Siam Syntech's fourth quarter ending June 30. ($1 = 26 baht)
